newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia eyes new east Europe trade opportunities.
newsitem.headline: Colombia eyes new east Europe trade opportunities.

text.p: Colombia will set up a network of trade offices in central and eastern Europe in a bid to open up new markets for its banana, flower and coal exports, the Foreign Trade Ministry said Wednesday.
The decision came after a meeting earlier this week between Foreign Trade Minister Carlos Ronderos and Colombian diplomats based in Austria, Hungary, Poland, Russia, Bulgaria and Romania.
Colombia's export promotion agency Proexport will be in charge of setting up Colombian Chambers of Trade in Europe although the ministry has set no deadline for their creation.
